exposure: enrollment in the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children
Pregnant persons with gestational diabetes mellitus
Enrollment in the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC)
outcome: Preterm delivery before 34 and 37 weeks of gestation
cohort: 460,377 pregnant persons with gestational diabetes mellitus covered by Medicaid
finding: Pregnant persons with gestational diabetes mellitus enrolled in WIC had decreased odds of preterm delivery but higher odds of large-for-gestational-age neonates and cesarean delivery compared to those who qualified but did not enroll.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher among the group enrolled in WIC.
